data_layout.phi_u: (N, 3, r_u), velocity components are x/y/z; z modes are zero for this 2D case

equations.raw: G da/dt = c_raw + A_raw a + H_raw(a,a) + P_raw b
equations.ode: da/dt = c + A a + H(a,a) + P b, with c/A/H/P = G^{-1} raw tensors

operator_metadata.compact_layout_note: When skip_raw=True, shared G_u/H/P are written once and per-Re arrays contain c/A only.
operator_metadata.weighted_l2_note: For this dataset phi_uv/phi_p are raw-space area-weighted POD modes and are M-orthonormal up to storage precision.

ppe_metadata.equation: L b = c_p + A_p a + H_p(a,a)
ppe_metadata.rhs_sign_convention: Delta p = -div((u dot grad)u); boundary terms are neglected in the projected weak form
